text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of summer camp!
It's a
period of intense training where
racers can
improve their skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Narita Brian and the other students
all board
the bus...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian! After achieving huge
success in the
Classic Triple Crown tour,
could you please share
a few words?

text_block_list.name: Newspaper Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I take it you're aware of the Triple
Crown
Champion Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you'll able to surpass the
formidable
bar set by the Emperor in
terms of G1 wins?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People's enthusiasm for Narita Brian
shows no
signs of cooling as she faces
off in the Classic
Triple Crown. Rather,
their expectations have
grown even
more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.
choice_data_list: 君は先にバスに乗ってて
貴方は先にバスに乗ってて

text_block_list.name: Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text: Wait! Brian? Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sigh...
choice_data_list: 取材の方はこちらで応対いたします！

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha, it's quite a spectacle out there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You okay? How're things going as
president?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I also tried to get out in front and deal
with the
press head on at first.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove did not approve, however.
She said
things would only get more
heated.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. They did all keep mentioning
your name
for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, well... there are those who would
like to
compare the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps we actually should compare
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch! So that's your style, eh? Dangling
bait in
front of me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I told you I'd accept your challenge back
when
you dragged me into the student
council, yet you
never compete with me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're also in the Twinkle Series, yet
you always
keep your distance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I've yet to see any real hunger in your
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
But when I finally line up next to you,
there will
be no escape.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to drag you into a real
contest one of
these days.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh. Well then, I'll bear that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inside the bus, the curtains are closed to
block
out the sun, which is blazing
hotter than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is on that cool, shaded bus that the
two racers
pledge to face each other.
